purpose: Population and coordinates of Quebec municipalities for the real-data run of m05_roads.py

licence.text: All data in Wikidata has a CC0 license. Wikidata avoids hosting data that lacks a CC0 license.

licence_line: CC0 1.0: "All data in Wikidata has a CC0 license. Wikidata avoids hosting data that lacks a CC0 license." (https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Wikidata:Licensing)
query_audit_exact:
SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?label ?pop ?coord WHERE {
  ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q3327873 .
  ?item p:P1082 ?st .
  ?st ps:P1082 ?pop ; pq:P585 ?pit .
  FILTER(YEAR(?pit) = 2021 && xsd:integer(?pop) > 25000)
  ?item wdt:P625 ?coord .
  ?item rdfs:label ?label . FILTER(LANG(?label) = "fr")
}
ORDER BY DESC(xsd:integer(?pop))
LIMIT 400
population_property: P1082 with point in time P585 in 2021 (2021 census as entered in Wikidata)
brief_defect: The suggested class Q3374262 is 'miasteczko' (a Polish small-town class): the query with it returned Romanian and Ukrainian towns. The class of municipalities of Quebec is Q3327873 ('local municipality of Quebec'); it is used in the audit query only (see below).
why_box_query: The Q3327873 class query omits Cote Saint-Luc (Q139588, typed only 'ville' and 'territoire hors MRC au Quebec'), which lies inside the top 40. The main query therefore selects by a geographic box and a 2021 population over 25 000, and the Quebec municipalities are then picked out by their Wikidata classes in this script.
